thesis: Portfolio resumes via a carry+MTM gap jump from 2026-06-08 (no intermediate trades invented for the skipped summer sessions). The 2026-09-01 pre-open pack is thin: routine politician PTR filings and generic single-name/crypto/personal-finance commentary (Shein IPO buzz, Bitcoin purchase timing, CD rates, dividend-stock listicles) with no dated, broad-market catalyst for a conservative core-ETF sleeve. Existing VTI position (~22.7 of ~107.7 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than forcing a trade on thin evidence, consistent with capital preservation.
